topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: Rain was drummin' against the window when I got the call. Should've known something was up when nobody picked up at my old friend’s place. “Surprise party’s off,” the voice on the other end said, flat and final. There was a silence, thick as a brick wall between us. I could hear the regret, the way it hung in the air, unsaid but heavy. I hung up, staring out into the night, the city lights blurred by the downpour. Sometimes, the best intentions get washed away, and all you're left with is the echo of what could've been. I shoulda known better. Maybe it’s time to start expectin' the other shoe to drop.
